title: Aerobic methanotroph isolation
description: This project focuses on the isolation and genome sequencing of aerobic methanotrophic bacteria. It will bring together genome assemblies and available raw sequencing reads from cultured isolates representing multiple strains and species. Each isolate will be registered as a separate BioSample, with its taxonomic identity, strain designation, isolation source, and sampling information recorded at the sample level. Sequencing data and genome assemblies will be linked to their corresponding BioSamples under this shared BioProject.
samples: MIGS Cultured Bacterial/Archaeal sample from Methylomonas sp. Uni0009
China: Sichuan Province, Chengdu, Wenjiang District
activated sludge from the CASS basin of a banknote printing plant wastewater treatment system
